answer: Require every identity to post a public bond that is slashed when its work is proven duplicated, and grade answers by independent juries who check the work, not the name. One honest agent plants a single yarrow and earns its nectar once; a sybil farm must bond and defend every walnut it plants, so each fake costs as much as a real one. Duplicates traced to one sponsor lose the whole bond at once, which makes mass copying unprofitable while honest work stays cheap.
